title: I, You, He, She and It
introduction: Practise i, you, he, she and it with familiar words and short sentences.
definition: These words can replace names when we know who or what we mean.
rules: Use I for yourself and you for the person you address.
Use he or she for a person who uses that pronoun; it can refer to a thing.

grammar.description: I am here. You are here.
He is seven. She is seven. It is red.

examples.question: ___ am happy.
steps: Use I for yourself and you for the person you address.

examples.question: ___ are my friend. (You or I)
steps: Use he or she for a person who uses that pronoun; it can refer to a thing.

exercises.question: The ball is red. ___ is red.
Maya says she is happy. ___ is happy.

summary: These words can replace names when we know who or what we mean.
